title: mcp: slim the open door's tool list (40 KB at tools/list; validate_expression alone is 7.8 KB)
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「同意你的所有建议，开始立专题子卡」. The ruling record is #34659 comment 6940528935.

## Why

Every connection pays for the tool list before any work starts, in the user's own tokens. Text that teaches belongs in the skill a client loads when it needs it; a tool description should carry what the call needs.

Who acts: the server lane (`packages/mcp`). Who reads the result: every MCP client.

## Evidence (objectstack `a0326b06`, `examples/app-crm`, admin API key, read 2026-11-17)

- `tools/list` → 17 tools, 40,341 bytes: descriptions 16,320, input schemas 20,925.
- Heaviest tools, description plus schema: `validate_expression` 7,791, `query_dataset` 5,508, `aggregate_records` 3,942, `run_action` 3,433, `create_upload_link` 2,883.
- `aggregate_records` carries a 1,126-byte tombstone for the removed `distinct` key inside its input schema.

## Scope

- Measure first: a per-tool table in the PR, before and after.
- Move teaching prose out of descriptions into the ask-data skill or `/mcp/skill`, keeping each description sufficient to call the tool correctly without the skill.
- Decide per tool whether a removed-key tombstone has to ride in `tools/list` or can live in the refusal alone.
- File surface: `packages/mcp/src/**`, and the spec files that own a description's text.

## Done when

- The table shows the new total, and no tool's call success drops in a scenario ask round run before and after.

## Out of scope

- Removing or renaming a tool. Changing what any tool accepts.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Do after the ask-data skill is published, so moved text has a home.
- Dedup, open and closed: `MCP tools/list description weight validate_expression` 0.
